5-7 in '25 (3-5 SBC) under first-year HC Tony Gibson (now Y2, no change). OFF p46 (an average unit whose 'bones are back'), DEF p64 by PFF but 'one of the worst defenses in the Sun Belt' per Athlon (a terrible pass D), SPEC p24 (poor).

The OFFENSE kept its core: QB Carlos Del Rio-Wilson (74.1, the SBC Preseason Off POY, efficient + the team's leading rusher) + 3 returning WR/TE starters (Tamarez/Norton + TE Payne, 3rd straight yr) + 2 OL starters (Slappy RG, Montgomery LT) + WVU transfers. But it lost its top RB (Allen -> ECU) + top WR (Lacey, yr4); RB1 is Barbie + FCS transfer Lester; the OL interior (C+LG) is now freshmen.

The DEFENSE was DECIMATED: the DL lost 3 of the top 4 sack leaders to the portal (Crowder/Hutson/Whyce/Kaba) - Braydin Ward (80.0) the lone real returner + transfers; LB has ONE returning starter (Gilmore, 11.5 TFL) + McBride (NC State) + Lewis; the secondary lost its top grader (Trotter 87.0) + 2 more starters off an already-bad pass D, keeping Daytione Smith ('one of the best SBC safeties') + Pierre-Louis + a slew of transfers.
ST reset: All-MAC K Lorcan Quinn left for Alabama; replaced by a Virginia transfer who has never kicked in college + a true freshman punter, off a SPEC-p24 unit.
